description: On-device voice isolation, wake words, voice activity and voiceprints. In the browser (WebAssembly), Python and Android, with plugins for LiveKit Agents, Pipecat and Home Assistant (ESPHome, Wyoming). No server, no key. Apache-2.0 code and weights.
